title: interviewer
description: One interviewer run: a question round, a spec, a type for a bug or task, a task's body, or, after a discussion hold, unchanged, plan or a human task's body. Set outcome, then only the fields that go with it.

outcome.description: questions: ask a round. spec: write the spec. typed: the issue is a bug or task; set type and nothing else. unchanged: only where the preamble allows it, after a discussion hold, when nothing in the discussion changes the issue, so it goes back to the stage it came from; set message at most. plan: only where the preamble allows it, after a discussion hold from planning, plan-review or planned, when the spec stands but its plan changes, its stories or tasks, so it goes to planning; set message, which plan requires, and nothing else. task: only where the preamble allows it, on a bug or a task with nothing open that blocks it, or after a discussion hold on a task whose body the discussion changes; set task and nothing else. human: only where the preamble allows it, after a discussion hold on a human task whose body the discussion changes; set human and nothing else.

type.description: The type you set on the issue. Only where you may set one.

message.description: A few lines for the owner: with a spec after revision notes, the answer to each note, or what changed; with unchanged, why the discussion changes nothing; with plan, always: what the discussion changes in the plan, written as notes for the planner.

questions.description: With outcome questions: this round's questions, most blocking first.

text.description: The question, in one line that stands alone.

blocks.description: The issue numbers the question blocks.

recommended.description: The option you recommend, listed first.

why.description: Why you recommend it, in one line.

others.description: The other options, one line each.

spec.description: With outcome spec: the spec's sections, as Markdown without headings.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable, testable statements, one line each.

decisions.description: Every question asked in any round, at least once, and each decision made without asking.

question.description: The question's ID, Q<round>.<number>, or empty for a decision made without asking.

answer.description: The option letter chosen, free for a free-text answer, superseded, dropped, or empty for a decision made without asking.

summary.description: In one line: the decision; for superseded, the ID of the question that replaced it; for dropped, why.

by.description: The login of the person whose answer this is, or empty when nobody answered.

round.description: The round the answer was given in: the latest round posted before the answering comment. 0 when nobody answered.

task.description: With outcome task: the task's issue body, in the task template's sections, as Markdown without headings. The daemon writes the header and the headings.

scope.description: One scope from the preamble's list, without the scope: prefix.

context.description: Markdown: what exists today, and which files matter.

change.description: Markdown: what to build, and the files it touches.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable, testable acceptance criteria, one line each.

test_plan.description: Markdown: which tests prove each criterion.

human.description: With outcome human: the human task's issue body, every field of the human task template filled. If you can't fill one, ask a question instead.

goal.description: One sentence: what the owner's action achieves.

why_blocks.description: What the work waits for, and why, in one line that reads on after "can't proceed until". Don't name the issues: the daemon puts their numbers first.

steps.description: Exact actions, with exact values, commands or settings, one line each, in order.

links.description: Direct links to the console page, file or doc, one line each.

done_when.description: The observable result the owner can check, in one line. When the task's Done when is a check the daemon runs, the daemon keeps its own sentence in its place.
